releases.summary: First release distributed as an image: one image for every component, installed and updated from the registry.
notes: One image, ghcr.io/fzield/waf, runs the control plane, the data plane, the console, the learning engine and the Kubernetes ingress controller, each as its own unprivileged user and group.

Hardened image on Ubuntu 24.04: no shell, no package manager; a component can neither execute nor read the other programs of the image; the control plane, the data plane and the ingress controller cannot start any program at all; read-only file systems and no capabilities in compose.yaml.
The installation kit (compose.yaml, examples, guide, licence) is inside the image: docker run --rm ghcr.io/fzield/waf:1 kit | tar -x -C /opt.
Updates in the console: a daily check for new versions, with their notes and the commands to run (it can be turned off, also with WAF_UPDATE_CHECK=off).
Weekly rebuild with the security updates of Ubuntu, published as a patch release when packages change.
Installations built from the sources move to the image keeping their data (same project name, services, volumes and settings): INSTALLATION.md, "Moving an installation built from the sources".
